title: System Utilities
summary: This module provides core utility functions for interacting with external systems, including browser operations (opening and searching web pages) and a centralized tool registry for executing various system tools.

nodes.label: Open Browser Page
nodes.title: BrowserOpen.Execute
nodes.description: Handles opening web pages, either from a cached state, a link ID on the current page, or by crawling a new URL. Manages the browser's page history and cache.

nodes.label: Search Browser
nodes.title: BrowserSearch.Execute
nodes.description: Executes a web search query, retrieves results, and constructs a search results page. It caches individual search result pages for later access.

nodes.label: Execute Registered Tool
nodes.title: Registry.Execute
nodes.description: Provides a centralized mechanism to execute registered tools by name, routing requests to the appropriate tool implementation.

nodes.label: Web Search Tool
nodes.title: Web Search Tool
nodes.description: An external dependency responsible for performing actual web searches and returning raw search results.

nodes.label: Browser Crawler
nodes.title: Browser Crawler
nodes.description: An external component used by BrowserOpen to fetch and parse content from new, uncached URLs.

groups.label: Browser Operations
groups.title: Browser Operations
groups.description: Handles all interactions related to web browsing, including opening pages, navigating, and performing searches.

groups.label: Tool Management
groups.title: Tool Management
groups.description: Manages the registration and execution of various system tools, providing a unified interface for tool invocation.
